h1.en: What Main-Cylinder and Swing-Cylinder Names Omit lists, with Axial piston pump as the illustration
h1.zh: 主油缸和摆缸的名称省略了什么列出的内容，用「Axial piston pump」做插图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery names a main-cylinder seal and a swing-cylinder seal among concrete pump parts in Xingtai. A swing-arm ball is named as well. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵配件里写出主油缸密封和摆缸密封，也写出摆臂球头。泵的性能仍在泵的页面上：功率、产量、压力和距离。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump: OelpumpeModel Retouched. Hebei Pinjin Machinery names a main-cylinder seal and a swing-cylinder seal among concrete pump parts in Xingtai. Pump performance stays on the pump page: power, output, pressure and distance. No bore, no stroke, no swing angle and no torque. A main-cylinder name does not change Electric 40's 23 MPa or Diesel 30's 20 MPa.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump页上的OelpumpeModel Retouched。河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵配件里写出主油缸密封和摆缸密封，也写出摆臂球头。如果需要尺寸，请打开配件页看该页实际列出的尺寸，或询问 /zh/contact/。

body.en: A swing-arm ball is named as well. A seal name is not a service manual. Do not fill those blanks from a general textbook or from another brand. Those are outlet-pressure entries on concrete pumps.
body.zh: 泵的性能仍在泵的页面上：功率、产量、压力和距离。主油缸这个名称不会改变电动40的 23 MPa 或柴油30的 20 MPa。

body.en: These words tell you the circuit has a main cylinder and a swing cylinder. The published names are main cylinder seal, swing cylinder seal and swing-arm ball, plus the S-tube and piston names on neighbouring part pages. If a size is required, open the part page for the sizes that page actually lists, or ask /en/contact/. Keep the assemblies and the performance entries in their own places.
body.zh: 已公布的名称包括主油缸密封、摆缸密封和摆臂球头，以及相邻配件页上的 S管和活塞名称。

body.en: They do not list cylinder bore, piston stroke or a step-by-step repair. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not add a cross-section drawing with dimensions in the pump specification tables. This article does not repeat size tables.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在泵的规格表里附加带尺寸的剖视图。

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list them on the concrete pump sheets. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械没有在混凝土泵参数页写出它们。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does a seal name include a repair sequence?
question.zh: 密封件名称包含维修顺序吗？

answer.en: No. The catalogue names the part. It does not list steps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump.
answer.zh: 不包含。目录点了零件名称。它没有标出步骤。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Where do I read pressure?

answer.en: On the concrete pump page that states outlet pressure or pumping pressure. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump.
answer.zh: 在写明出口压力或泵送压力的混凝土泵页面上。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is the swing cylinder the same as the S-tube?
question.zh: 摆缸和S管是同一个零件吗？

answer.en: The catalogue gives them different names: swing-cylinder seal and S-tube seal. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump.
answer.zh: 目录给了它们不同的名称：摆缸密封和 S管密封。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axial_piston_pump画面里印出的数字。
